definition: the skin that closes down over the eye
description: A close view of a young woman standing outside in falling snow at dusk. She has dark hair, a pink knitted scarf and a cream parka with a fur-trimmed hood, and she tilts her face up with both eyes closed. A single large white snowflake rests on her closed eyelid among the lashes, and smaller flakes sit in her hair. The snowflake melts away, she smiles, opens her eyes and laughs up at the sky. Behind her, snowy fir trees and an old street lamp glow softly out of focus in the blue evening light.

en.question: What is melting on her eyelid?
